notes.title: Super reaKtor: A little delay, be we keep going!
notes.notes:
[h1]We are still there![/h1]

Super reaKtor's development is still on, but we had to delay the initial release date.
Why? a mix of personnal and technical issues, motivation (thanks, winter).

[b]HOWEVER[/b]

We still continue, and things are getting more and more precise.
- We just finished the new kompendium
- We squash some bugs
- We complete the last reaKtor
- We implement some... additional content ːsenpaiː
- We make everything even more stylish
- We add even more triskels.

You will soon be able to secure the reaKtors like never before !

notes.title: I tried the demo of Super reaKtor and it really fried my brain
notes.notes:
Super reaKtor is a unique bullet hell where you absorb various orbs using your laser beam, and while the idea is great it really did annihilate my brain.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2024/08/i-tried-the-demo-of-super-reaktor-and-it-really-fried-my-brain

notes.title: Super reaKtor is the most insane-looking bullet hell I've seen in a good while
notes.notes:
Think you have fast reflexes? Super reaKtor looks like it will thoroughly test you with its rather unique take on bullet hell.
